game.q: why point at a mother, not just say “God is merciful”? your guess?
opts: so they could feel it, not just hear it

wrong.known: nope. she was a stranger in a crowd.
wrong.fire: the fire was a question, not a warning.

game.right: YES. a mother’s love is the strongest mercy most people have seen. he said: more than that.

end.line: a mother searched a crowd for her baby. God’s mercy, he said, is more than that.
end.l1: a mother’s love in a crowd.
